# Main Street AI Brief
> Plain-English AI for small business owners: what works, what to avoid, and what it means for your shop.

- [Most small businesses use AI. Few feel confident with it.](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/issues/ai-confidence-gap.html)
- [The barrier is expertise, not cost](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/issues/expertise-not-cost.html)
- [Only 23% of small firms have a written AI policy](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/issues/ai-policy-gap.html)

## Use cases
- [Answer Google reviews in 5 minutes a day](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/answer-google-reviews.html): A simple daily routine and a copy-paste prompt to reply to every Google review, good or bad, in your own voice, without sounding canned.
- [Chase an unpaid invoice without sounding rude](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/chase-unpaid-invoices.html): Write a firm, friendly three-step payment reminder sequence with AI, so late invoices get paid and the customer relationship survives.
- [Write a job post that gets better applicants](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/write-a-job-post.html): Turn what you actually need from a new hire into a clear, honest job post and a short screening question, with AI doing the first draft.
- [Turn job-site notes into a clear estimate customers understand](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/job-notes-to-estimate.html): Turn walkthrough notes into a clean, itemized estimate with plain-English scope and exclusions. You set the prices; AI writes it up for you to check.
- [Follow up on quotes that went quiet](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/follow-up-on-quotes.html): A three-message follow-up plan for quotes with no reply, written once with AI and reused, so fairly priced jobs don't go to whoever followed up first.
- [Tell customers about a price increase without losing them](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/announce-a-price-increase.html): Use AI to draft a short, honest price-change notice and a phone script for regulars, so customers hear it from you early, with reasons and a date.
- [Write product descriptions for 50 items in an afternoon](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/write-product-descriptions.html): A batch method for writing accurate, on-brand product descriptions with AI from your own spec notes, in batches of 10, without the generic filler.
- [Answer the same customer questions once: hours, orders, allergens](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/answer-repeat-customer-questions.html): Turn the 10 questions customers ask every day into one accurate FAQ and a set of saved replies, so you stop typing the same answers in DMs and on the phone.
- [Turn meeting notes into a client recap email in 5 minutes](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/meeting-notes-to-client-recap.html): Send a clear recap of decisions, next steps and owners within the hour after every client meeting, drafted by AI from your notes and checked by you.
- [Get clients to send their documents on time](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/get-client-documents-on-time.html): Build a plain-English document checklist and a friendly three-step reminder sequence with AI, so you spend less of busy season chasing paperwork.
- [Cut no-shows with better reminders and a clear deposit policy](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/cut-no-shows.html): Write a friendly cancellation and deposit policy plus a reminder sequence with AI, so clients know the rules before they book and fewer forget.
- [Win back clients who haven't rebooked](https://mainstreetaibrief.com/use-cases/rebook-lapsed-clients.html): Find regulars who are past their usual rebooking window and send a short, personal note, drafted with AI, that brings them back without discount-dumping.
